reason: Part 1 comparability follows by applying the current strict-range square-function theorem to each admissible partition. Part 2 is false as stated: it says every mixed symbol is supported in an intersection of annular supports, but the low-frequency blocks φ₀ and ψ₀ are not annular and satisfy φ₀(0)=ψ₀(0)=1, so φ₀ψ₀ is nonzero at the origin. Restrict the annular wording to positive indices and state the low-block support separately (or say intersection of the actual supports). The cited support bounds do prove vanishing when |j−k|≥3, including low/high pairs.
